subject: 官署衙门
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert this historical escort depot into a Southern Song magistrate government YAMEN. Keep the exact reference ground geometry, perimeter layout, camera angle, roof direction, front gate position, base outline, full building proportions absolutely unchanged. This reference already has the correct2:1 orthographic geometry with both base edges at equal +/-26.565 degree angles. Replace wooden cargo cart and ALL crates with a single modest drum stand, convert the bare earth to stone-paved administrative court, make the existing rear hall slightly more formal with reddish brown columns but retain its massing, remove cargo bags from side room. Keep same muted natural grey tile, warm plaster and brown timber, upper-left light. Ground footprint intended16x12 (1.333), close to this14x11 reference (1.273); preserve contour rather than changing camera. No ornate imperial palace, no text/signboards, no people, no modern objects. True transparent RGBA background and minimum10% clear margin, preserve complete eaves. No halo or thick pedestal. Do not change the base slopes or ground corner arrangement.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: 本轮未获审批候选，投影/材质参考

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 第2次运行返修：内置image_gen真实重出主体；逐张view_image及64×32占地叠图，宽深关系和两轴目视协调，左上光、暖灰瓦木石、宋意象，无文字人物现代物；无裁切。严格几何数值见geometry_qa；不将轻微告警当成已通过。
